gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.02759 38.893662)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-77.02759, 38.893662), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
terrain_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)::geometry, 100), true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    poi_geom p
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom, 4326)::geometry)
),
ruggedness_index AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_RuggednessIndex(clipped_rast) AS ruggedness
  FROM 
    terrain_clip
)
SELECT 
  ruggedness
FROM 
  ruggedness_index;
